title: TEXAS CAPITAL BANCSHARES INC/TX 8-K Filing — 2026-04-23
summary: Texas Capital Bancshares filed a Form 8-K disclosing Q1 2026 operating results (fiscal quarter ended March 31, 2026), a COO promotion, and results from its April 21, 2026 annual meeting where stockholders rejected a proposal to redomesticate from Delaware to Texas and defeated a measure to raise the threshold for shareholder proposals.
key_points: John Cummings appointed Managing Director and Chief Operating Officer effective April 16, 2026
All 10 director nominees elected to board
Ernst & Young ratified as independent auditor for 2026
Redomestication proposal (Delaware to Texas) rejected: 22,047,429 votes against vs 18,181,458 for
Proposal to raise threshold for shareholder proposals rejected: 35,015,189 votes against vs 5,209,051 for
Adjournment proposal to solicit additional proxies not approved
